summary: Frontend-only visual verification of driver cabin fix in CargaOrden.jsx. Mobile viewport 390x844. Login 1122/1122 succeeded. Clicking carga-next-step transitions to carga-orden-view (Orden de carga) which renders correctly with numbered boxes (1,2,3) and 'recogidas' label. SVG defs (coCab, coGlass, coHead) all present in DOM. The orange cab in carga-orden-view now clearly shows a light-blue gradient windshield and yellow headlight glow — no longer flat. Coherent with the cab styling in carga-view. Regression: dashboard-card-sacas (Ordenar Sacas) and dashboard-card-route (Ordenar ruta) both load without errors. Zero page errors and zero console errors across the whole flow.
